The Maiden Tower#000.src: Fine then. Consider yourself lucky that I'm in a...mood. I'll talk with you instead of crackin' yer bones for my bread.

The Maiden Tower#001.src: Ogres are tough. We're independent and solitary folks. You don't bother us or interfere with our life, we leave well enough alone.

The Maiden Tower#002.src: And...well, when it's two ogres getting together, it's simple. But... I passed by a tall tower, and heard a maiden's voice from inside...
The Maiden Tower#002.dst: 而且……嗯，如果是两个食人魔凑在一起，那很简单。可是……我路过一座高塔，听到里面传来一位少女的声音。

The Maiden Tower#003.src: If you can help me out, I'd be real grateful. I'm sure I've got somethin' that you'd like in exchange.

The Maiden Tower#004.src: Ohoho! An admirer? Such a lovely, rugged accent! However...if you wish to meet me, I'd like to see your devotion, yes?
The Maiden Tower#004.dst: 噢呵呵！有仰慕者？多么可爱又粗犷的口音！不过……如果你想见我，我想先看看你的诚意，好吗？

The Maiden Tower#005.src: There is a lovely urn my father had before. He took it with him to the grave, and I do miss my dear father so.

The Maiden Tower#006.src: I go into {p}, I'll get attacked. I get attacked, I attack back. They'll come after us...wouldn't want to present her with that. You get that urn for me, alright?
The Maiden Tower#006.dst: 我一进 {p} 就会被攻击。我被攻击就会还手。然后他们就会追杀我们……我可不想拿这种事去见她。你帮我把骨灰坛拿来，好吗？

The Maiden Tower#008.src: I've got you some compensation already, so don't worry about gettin' snubbed for credit. Thank you kindly for the help.

The Maiden Tower#009.src: Ohoho...you're one of those Humans I've read about, aren't you? Did you truly intend to be my suitor, dear?~
The Maiden Tower#009.dst: 噢呵呵……你是我在书里读到的那种人类吧？你真的打算当我的求婚者吗，亲爱的？～

The Maiden Tower#010.src: Oh...my...goodness! A big, strong, strapping ogre!! Not a fairytale, my foot! And so polite, too... Oh, you'll make a perfect husband, heehee~
The Maiden Tower#010.dst: 噢……我的……天哪！又高又壮、魁梧结实的食人魔！！还说不是童话，才怪！而且这么有礼貌……噢，你会是个完美的丈夫，嘻嘻～

The Maiden Tower#011.src: Now I'm sure you'll find a nice lad somewhere who'll take you for who you are, but until you find someone that has no standards, shove your creepy lips where I can't see 'em!!

The Maiden Tower#012.src: ...I...I g-guess he was rotten to the core, despite his...l-luscious exterior...but, you'll make me feel better, right, you s-studly human? Right?! RIGHT?!!
The Maiden Tower#012.dst: ……我……我、我想他虽然外表……那么诱人……骨子里却烂透了……不过你会让我好受点的，对吧，你这个帅、帅气的人类？对吧？！对吧？！！

The Maiden Tower#014.src: Ah! What are you doing in my swamp?! Don't you know that Ogres live alone for a reason?
The Maiden Tower#014.dst: 啊！你在我的沼泽里干什么？！你不知道食人魔独居是有原因的吗？
The Maiden Tower#014.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#015.src: Eh? You're from across the sea, a land called Win? You certainly don't look like a winner to me, ya small fry.
The Maiden Tower#015.dst: 嗯？你是从海那边来的，一个叫 Win 的地方？你看起来可一点都不像赢家，小不点。
The Maiden Tower#015.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#016.src: Fine then. Consider yourself lucky I'm in a... mood. I'll talk with you instead of crackin' yer bones for my bread.
The Maiden Tower#016.dst: 好吧。算你走运，我现在正好……有心情。我就跟你聊聊，不把你的骨头磨了做面包。
The Maiden Tower#016.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#017.src: Ogres are tough. We're independent and solitary folks. You don't bother us or interfere with our life, we leave you alone.
The Maiden Tower#017.dst: 食人魔很强悍。我们独立又孤僻。你不来烦我们、不干涉我们的生活，我们就不管你。
The Maiden Tower#017.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#018.src: That is, until it's time to find ourselves a partner. Then we'll turn over hell and highwater ta be together.
The Maiden Tower#018.dst: 直到该找伴侣的时候。到那时，我们就算上刀山下火海也要在一起。
The Maiden Tower#018.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#020.src: Ogres don't live in fairytale towers, or have a voice that could make flowers grow with its lovely lilt!
The Maiden Tower#020.dst: 食人魔可不住童话里的高塔，也没有那种婉转动听、能让花都开起来的嗓音！
The Maiden Tower#020.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#021.src: I've been tryin' ta figure out how to approach this... I'm gettin' on in years, I need to find someone, and she's the girl.
The Maiden Tower#021.dst: 我一直在想该怎么接近她……我年纪也不小了，得找个伴，而她就是那个人。
The Maiden Tower#021.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#022.src: If you can help me out, I'll be real grateful. I'm sure I've got something that you'd like in exchange.
The Maiden Tower#022.dst: 如果你能帮我，我会非常感激。我相信我有些你会想要的东西可以交换。
The Maiden Tower#022.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#023.src: Follow the rocky-looking path to find the tower. I'll meet with you there- prepare to be a wingman for an ogre.
The Maiden Tower#023.dst: 沿着那条满是石头的小路就能找到塔。我在那里跟你会合——准备好给食人魔当僚机吧。
The Maiden Tower#023.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#024.src: Follow the stones in the path to the tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#024.dst: 沿着路上的石头前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的塔

The Maiden Tower#025.src: This is the place. She's up at the top... Remember, I won't stop 'til I meet her. Coming here means you're in for the long haul.
The Maiden Tower#025.dst: 就是这里。她在最上面……记住，我不见到她是不会罢休的。来了这里，就代表你得奉陪到底。
The Maiden Tower#025.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#026.src: I hear a voice outside! Oh, who might it be, I wonder~
The Maiden Tower#026.dst: 我听到外面有声音！噢，会是谁呢，真好奇～
The Maiden Tower#026.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#027.src: Here goes... Hello, fair lady of the tower! I am Sherk! I heard your voice on the road- and I must meet you myself! ...that's formal enough, right?
The Maiden Tower#027.dst: 来了……你好，塔上美丽的小姐！我是 Sherk！我在路上听到了你的声音——我一定要亲自见你一面！……这样够正式了吧？
The Maiden Tower#027.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#029.src: Woman, you have no idea what you're sayin' when you ask for devotion.
The Maiden Tower#029.dst: 女人，你要人拿出诚意，根本不知道自己在说什么。
The Maiden Tower#029.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#030.src: There is a lovely urn my father had before. He took it with him to his grave, and I do miss my dear father so.
The Maiden Tower#030.dst: 我父亲以前有个很漂亮的骨灰坛。他把它一起带进了坟墓，而我好想念我亲爱的父亲。
The Maiden Tower#030.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#031.src: Retrieve the urn for me, so I can have a memento of him. Brave the crypts of {p}, behind the bank... And prove your devotion, dear suitor~
The Maiden Tower#031.dst: 帮我把骨灰坛拿回来，让我有个纪念他的东西。闯进银行后面的 {p} 墓穴……证明你的诚意吧，亲爱的求婚者～
The Maiden Tower#031.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#032.src: ...I'll return! You'll get your urn, no doubt! ... ...and a lovely fine boot up my backside. I don't fancy a massacre for a piece of pottery, Win person.
The Maiden Tower#032.dst: ……我会回来的！你一定会拿到你的骨灰坛！……还有屁股上结结实实挨一脚。我可不想为了一个陶罐大开杀戒，Win 人。
The Maiden Tower#032.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#034.src: Find the urn in the {p} Catacombs, behind the {p} bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#034.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 地下墓穴找到骨灰坛，墓穴就在 {p} 银行后面

The Maiden Tower#035.src: And this is why I asked your help. As nice as blood spreads on toast, I have to reserve my sensibilities for the miss.
The Maiden Tower#035.dst: 这就是我找你帮忙的原因。血抹在吐司上是很好吃，但我得在小姐面前保持点风度。
The Maiden Tower#035.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#036.src: I've got you some compensation already, so don't worry about getting snubbed for credit. Thank you kindly for the help.
The Maiden Tower#036.dst: 你的报酬我已经准备好了，不用担心功劳被抢。谢谢你的帮忙。
The Maiden Tower#036.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#037.src: Just one last thing. I doubt she'll be expecting an ogre of all people to climb up her tower. I don't want her to get frightened away.
The Maiden Tower#037.dst: 还有最后一件事。我想她大概想不到爬上塔的会是个食人魔。我不想把她吓跑。
The Maiden Tower#037.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#038.src: So, Win person. Care to temper her expectations before I arrive? Head up before me.
The Maiden Tower#038.dst: 所以，Win 人。能不能在我到之前先给她打个预防针？你先上去。
The Maiden Tower#038.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#039.src: Enter the tower and make Sherk confess his love to the maiden.
The Maiden Tower#039.dst: 进入塔中，让 Sherk 向少女表白。

The Maiden Tower#041.src: Not exactly, milady! I'm the one seeking your affections- Coming up the ladder. I know I may not be a fairytale husband, but-
The Maiden Tower#041.dst: 不完全是，小姐！想赢得您芳心的是我——正在爬梯子上来。我知道我可能不是童话里的丈夫，但是——
The Maiden Tower#041.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#044.src: Aren't your type supposed to be less... Ehm... Clefted? Grizzled? Pale?
The Maiden Tower#044.dst: 你们这种人不是应该没那么……呃……下巴裂？胡子拉碴？脸色惨白？
The Maiden Tower#044.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#045.src: Oh, come here, Sherky-pie, give me a big kiss! And no need to worry, there's plenty more in store for my big hubby after that~
The Maiden Tower#045.dst: 噢，过来嘛，Sherk 小甜心，给我一个大大的吻！别担心，之后还有好多好多留给我的大老公呢～
The Maiden Tower#045.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#046.src: Cor, lady! Even for an ogre you're layin' it on a bit thick! Aah, you see, ogres, and people like you, they have layers, right? And your first one is... Eh... ...rotten.
The Maiden Tower#046.dst: 天哪，小姐！就算对食人魔来说，你也太肉麻了吧！啊，你看，食人魔，还有你们这种人，都是有很多层的，对吧？而你的第一层是……呃……烂透了。
The Maiden Tower#046.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#047.src: Now I'm sure you'll find a nice lad somewhere who'll take you for who you are, but until you find someone who has no standards, shove your creepy lips where I can't see 'em!!
The Maiden Tower#047.dst: 我相信你总会找到一个肯接受真实的你的好小伙，不过在你找到那种毫无标准的人之前，把你那吓人的嘴唇收到我看不见的地方去！！
The Maiden Tower#047.speaker: Sherk
